why_fit: One of two qualified OEMs for UHP neon reclaim skids (SYNTHETIC premise); certification moat and 2-3y capacity lead time make it a direct beneficiary of the reclaim build-out.

evidence.summary: Reclaim-skid segment = 35% of revenue; booked capacity POs disclosed; one customer contract carries a partial price-escalator clause.
Fab operators quoted on multi-quarter skid waitlists.
The two qualified skid OEMs hold >=70% of certified reclaim-capacity installs.
Valuation rich: trades above the information/industrial-gas peer median and consensus estimates already carry the reclaim build-out.
Known but not crowded: moderate coverage; price not extended versus estimate revisions.

known_risks: Pricing power is episodic; a reclaim capacity glut or a neon-free laser platform would break the node; 65% of the company is unrelated industrial gas distribution.
missing_info: Skid-segment gross margin not disclosed separately.
suggested_next_step: GATE, then EVALUATE with bear-case-first if it clears.
